summary: String methods clean up, search, cut, and split text. Each one returns a new String, so you save the result in a variable.
notes: course.substring(1, 4) includes index 1 and stops before index 4. substring(4) goes to the end.
indexOf() returns -1 when the text is not found. contains() returns true or false.
split(",") returns a String[] array. String.join(" | ", names) joins it with a separator.
pitfall: course.substring(4, 20) on an 8-character String throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. The end index can be at most course.length().
